_comment: Written for this project from SteelMC's README, release workflow and source (config/config.toml, 'Started Steel Server', SIGINT/SIGTERM shutdown). SteelMC reads console input through a terminal library, so console commands do not reach it in a container; the panel stops it with SIGINT. Not an upstream egg.
name: SteelMC (experimental)
author: game-manager@localhost
description: SteelMC, an independent Rust implementation of the Minecraft Java Edition server. Experimental: survival gameplay is incomplete and no plugins or mod loaders are supported (upstream README). Console commands are not available because SteelMC needs a terminal for input.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# SteelMC installation: downloads a published Linux build. Written for this project; SteelMC
# itself publishes no egg. Server files: /mnt/server
set -eu
apk add --no-cache curl
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64|amd64) ASSET=steel-linux-musl ;;
    *) echo "SteelMC publishes Linux release builds for x86_64 only"; exit 1 ;;
esac
if [ -n "${DOWNLOAD_URL:-}" ]; then
    URL="${DOWNLOAD_URL}"
elif [ "${VERSION:-latest}" = "latest" ]; then
    URL="https://github.com/Steel-Foundation/SteelMC/releases/latest/download/${ASSET}"
else
    URL="https://github.com/Steel-Foundation/SteelMC/releases/download/${VERSION}/${ASSET}"
fi
echo "Downloading SteelMC from: ${URL}"
curl -fsSL "${URL}" -o steel.part
chmod +x steel.part
mv steel.part steel
# The first start writes config/config.toml, whose port the panel then sets.
if [ ! -f config/config.toml ]; then
    timeout 10 ./steel < /dev/null || true
fi
test -f config/config.toml || { echo "SteelMC did not create its configuration"; exit 1; }
echo "Install complete"

variables.name: Release
variables.description: Release tag to install, or latest.

variables.name: Download URL
variables.description: Optional direct link to a steel-linux-musl build; overrides Release.
